author: Felipe Blassioli
abstract: Shapes a loose intent into a well-formed prompt for a Claude Code session (an agent that gathers context, uses tools, asks questions). Matches the intent to a validated archetype from the bundled references/prompt-archetypes.md, fills the universal slots (objective, context to gather, anchors, clarify-first, acceptance criteria, verification, output contract, stop conditions), routes the tier via model-recommender, and self-checks with prompt-audit so the emitted prompt passes its own linter. Holds no routing data or model strings of its own. Learns from use: after each shaping it offers to capture the case to an external, never-committed ledger (~/.claude/smart-prompt-ledger.md); recurring, generalizable, sanitized cases are promoted (human-gated) into the public catalog plus a regression eval. Authors prompts (generative) where prompt-audit critiques them (adversarial) — the two compose.
